title.zh: 【Network School 将收购 Farcaster，Neynar 多数团队成员加入】
title.en: 【Network School 将收购 Farcaster，Neynar 多数团队成员加入】

current_state.zh: Network School will acquire the Farcaster decentralized social protocol, app and codebase, with most of Neynar's team joining to continue development while co-founder Rishav Mukherji and others depart.
current_state.en: Network School will acquire the Farcaster decentralized social protocol, app and codebase, with most of Neynar's team joining to continue development while co-founder Rishav Mukherji and others depart.
